args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

Unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
Fix versions: 2.9.4 / 3.1.0.

args.head: upgrade/fastjson-2.9.4-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Security
Fixes **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: `<2.9.4` (also `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`). Fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0; this is the minimal compatible fix for the current 2.x line.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on branch `upgrade/fastjson-2.9.4-cve-2026-31337` — passed.
